items.imageCaption: Image caption, Oliva (second from left) won Commonwealth bronze for Team Wales as part of the women's team pursuit in Glasgow | Image caption, Oliva now has three children with husband Lewis - and both parents were selected for the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games.
items.author: Tom Brown
items.excerpt: Cyclist and mum-of-three Ciara Oliva says she has 'unfinished business' at the Olympics after making a remarkable return to the British Cycling programme.
